description: This file defines an abstract class 'ValueTypeSerializer' and a generic implementation 'ValueTypeSerializer<T>' for serializing value types that implement ISerializable. It includes methods for writing and reading values, handling serialization callbacks, and working with serialization info, specifically tailored to a serialization framework within Orleans.

classes.name: ValueTypeSerializer
classes.description: An abstract base class for serializers that handle value types, defining methods for reading and writing values generically.

classes.name: ValueTypeSerializer<T>
classes.description: A concrete serializer for struct types that implement ISerializable, supporting custom constructors, callbacks, and detailed serialization/deserialization logic.

methods.name: WriteValue
methods.description: Serializes a value of type T, invoking serialization callbacks, gathering object data, and writing fields to the writer.

methods.name: ReadValue
methods.description: Deserializes data from the reader into a value of type T, invoking deserialization callbacks and reconstructing the object.
